about: Placement and naming conventions for Generate-Config additions, one card per role / base class. A class takes the first card whose match it meets (cards are tried in order); a lab class inherits its base's card through its MRO. Every rule here is [derived] from the classes' own fields and *_label properties and is checked by the environment's load; none is cited.

cards.title: CZ gate with both qubits moving
cards.notes: flux_pulse_high plays on the qubit with the higher f_01 (ties go to the control), flux_pulse_low on the other.

cards.title: CZ gate with a flux pulse on each qubit
cards.notes: flux_pulse_qubit plays on the pair's control, flux_pulse_target on its target.

cards.title: CZ gate (one moving qubit)
cards.notes: flux_pulse_qubit plays on the pair's moving qubit (qubit_pair.moving_qubit).

cards.title: CZ gate played on the tunable coupler
cards.notes: coupler_flux_pulse plays on the pair's coupler; a pair without a coupler line cannot hold it.

cards.title: Readout pulse
cards.notes: A readout pulse sits on the qubit's resonator.

cards.title: Measure macro
cards.notes: The qubit's measure macro is named measure; it plays a readout pulse of the qubit's resonator by name.

cards.title: Pulse
cards.notes: A pulse goes into one channel's operations dict.

cards.title: Pulsed TWPA preset
cards.notes: Not a class: a pump_ pulse plus the extras.twpa_pulse_mode flag, and active_twpa_names only when the chosen root declares it.

cards.title: No pulse on a QDAC-II bias line

forbidden.reason: its z is a QdacBiasLine (a DC level), which plays no pulses; put the pulse on xy or the resonator
